label: Corticosteroid Therapy and Long-Term Outcomes of Post-Infectious Inflammatory Syndrome in Non-HIV Immunosuppressed Cryptococcal Meningitis: A Multicenter Case Series.
summary: Post-infectious inflammatory response syndrome (PIIRS) is recognized as a cause of neurologic deterioration in previously healthy patients with cryptococcal meningoencephalitis (CM). However, data on non-human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), immunosuppressed patients remain limited. Between July 2018 and April 2025, 13 non-HIV immunosuppressed patients with CM who subsequently developed PIIRS were included.
